entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: Hey, welcome.

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: This is Protein Lovers, a gym for[n]anyone who wants a healthy bod.
entries.uk: Це «Protein Lovers», спортзал для[n]всіх, хто хоче здорове тіло.

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: Looks like you're not a member yet.[n]You should consider it!
entries.uk: Схоже, ти ще не член клубу.[n]Подумай про це!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't have the money for that...
entries.uk: У тебе нема на це грошей...

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: Oh, you don't wanna become[n]a member? You totally should![n]We can sweat it out together!
entries.uk: О, не хочеш стати членом клубу?[n]А дарма! Попітніли б разом!

entries.en: On second thought...
Maybe another time.

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: I see... I hope you come again!

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: Gotcha. That one, huh? Come[n]on over whenever you like!

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: Now, to commemorate your[n]membership, you can train today[n]no matter which pass you chose.
entries.uk: А на честь твого вступу[n]сьогодні можна тренуватися[n]з будь-яким абонементом.

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: You came all the way here,[n]so why not have at it?
entries.uk: Ти ж аж сюди прийшов,[n]то чому б не спробувати?

entries.en: I'll train.
I'll pass.

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: Once you leave, you can only come[n]back during your designated time[n]slots. You okay with that?
entries.uk: Щойно підеш, повернутися зможеш[n]лише у свої години.[n]Тебе це влаштовує?

entries.en: I don't mind.
I'll train.

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: I see... Well, come again[n]when you feel like it!

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: All righty then! Go on and train[n]to your heart's content!

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: Ooh, didn't expect you to choose[n]that one. You must be planning[n]some serious training.
entries.uk: Ого, не чекав, що ти вибереш[n]цей. Мабуть, плануєш[n]серйозні тренування.

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: Now the gym is your oyster![n]Come on over to break a[n]sweat whenever you want!
entries.uk: Тепер спортзал у твоєму[n]розпорядженні! Приходь[n]попітніти будь-коли!

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: Well then, do you wanna[n]start training right away?
I'll train.
I'll pass.

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: I see... Well, come again[n]when you feel like it!

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: All righty then! Go on and train[n]to your heart's content!

entries.en: Hey! Welcome!

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer
entries.en: So, what are you here for?
I want to get a membership.
I want to change my pass.
I want to train.
I don't need anything.

entries.speaker: Personal Trainer

I don't see my friends here...[n]I should go somewhere else...

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Oh, you're that guy that was with[n]Sakamoto...
entries.uk: О, ти той хлопець, що був[n]із Сакамото...

entries.en: What's bonkin'?
Hello.
I'm his friend.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Oh no, not you too...
entries.uk: О ні, і ти туди ж...

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Hahah, no need to be so polite.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: I thought so.[n]No wonder you looked familiar.
entries.uk: Так я і думав.[n]Недарма ти здався знайомим.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: S'it true that Sakamoto wants to go[n]back to the track team so much that[n]he's moving just so he can do rehab?
entries.uk: Це правда, що Сакамото так хоче[n]повернутися до легкої атлетики,[n]що навіть узявся за реабілітацію?

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: I felt so happy hearing that![n]It'd be lame if he didn't do anything!
entries.uk: Я так зрадів, коли почув![n]Було б кепсько, якби він нічого не робив!

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: So, I'm plannin' on helping him as[n]much as possible.
entries.uk: Тож я планую допомагати йому[n]чим тільки зможу.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Don't you think it'd be awesome if he[n]and I'd be able to run together again?
entries.uk: Скажи, було б круто, якби ми з ним[n]знову бігали разом?

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: So I heard Sakamoto's not coming back[n]to the team...
entries.uk: Я чув, Сакамото не повертається[n]до команди...

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: I feel like it's a waste of talent, but if that's[n]the path he chooses, I'll accept it.
entries.uk: Як на мене, це марнування таланту, але[n]якщо він обрав такий шлях, я прийму це.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Maybe he'll want to come back one of[n]these days.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: If that happens, I sure would love to run[n]with him again.
entries.uk: Якщо так, я б залюбки знову[n]побігав із ним.

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: I can run with Sakamoto again.[n]This is so awesome!
entries.uk: Я знову бігатиму з Сакамото.[n]Це так круто!

entries.speaker: Ikeda-senpai
entries.en: Well, if Sakamoto comes back to the[n]track team one day, I sure would want[n]to run with him.
entries.uk: Що ж, якщо Сакамото колись повернеться[n]до команди, я б залюбки[n]побігав із ним.

entries.en: I said my goodbyes to Ikeda-senpai.[n]I should go elsewhere.
entries.uk: Я попрощався з Ікедою-семпаєм.[n]Варто піти деінде.
